test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The area of a sector of a circle having radius 14 cm is 231 cm². Find the degree measure of the corresponding central angle. (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circle, r = 14 cm

Area of the sector, A = 231 cm²

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Area of a sector = (θ / 360) × π × r²

where θ is the central angle in degrees.

**Calculation:**

⇒ (θ / 360) × (22/7) × 14² = 231

⇒ (θ / 360) × (22/7) × 196 = 231

⇒ (θ / 360) × 616 = 231

⇒ θ / 360 = 231 / 616

⇒ θ / 360 = 0.375

⇒ θ = 0.375 × 360

⇒ θ = 135

**The degree measure of the corresponding central angle is 135º.**
